author: Kendra Barnett
title: Perion Exits Nasdaq in $420M Sale to India’s Affle as Open-Web Squeeze Continues
description: Affle is buying Perion for $420 million, but once Perion’s cash is stripped out it’s paying under $200 million for the business, the latest open-web adtech exit at a bargain price.
content:
Indian performance marketing firm Affle is acquiring Perion, an adtech firm focused on connected TV (CTV), digital out-of-home (DOOH), and retail media for $420 million.
